Pin @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.4, consolidate Dependabot updates (#126 @babel/eslint-parser 8.0.6, #127 codeql-action SHAs, #137 @types/node 26.6.4, #138 pm-cli 2026.10.4 superset, #139 jscpd 5.4.0), fix Dependabot security alert #3 (brace-expansion 5.0.12), and prove the full release gate green.

value.author: pi-cert-a
value.text: Starting certification on PM CLI 2026.10.4. Pinning @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.10.4 (supersedes Dependabot #138 which proposed 2026.10.1), @babel/eslint-parser ^8.0.6 (#126), jscpd ^5.4.0 (#139), @types/node lockfile 26.6.4 (newer than #137's 26.6.3), and codeql-action SHAs 2892aa5e (#127). Security alert #3 (brace-expansion) fixed via npm audit fix -> 5.0.12; npm audit --omit=dev clean. Note: the braces GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm advisory flags ALL published braces versions (vulnerable <=3.0.3, no patched release); its only path into the tree is the jscpd4 dev alias kept for duplication-gate v4-engine parity tests (peer floor jscpd >=4.3.0 <6.0.0), so it is refused rather than weakening the gate.

value.text:
Gate evidence: `npm run release:check` green end-to-end on the branch (typecheck, lint, duplication, docstring, coverage 100/100/100/100, audit:prod clean, pack:dry-run 50 files, changelog:check up to date, all release verifiers ok) plus `pm health --strict-exit --require-merge-drivers` ok. npm audit --omit=dev: 0 vulnerabilities.

Dogfood (packed pm-ops-2026.10.4.tgz installed into a scratch copy of this repo's tracker at /tmp/claude-1000/cert-wt/pm-ops-dogfood):
- npm: `npx -y @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.4 ops status --repos fleet/pm-ops` -> 'status: 1/1 ready, 0 issue(s)'; `ops policy` -> 'passed: 6, failed: 0'; `ops scan` -> 'scan: 1/1 ready'.
- bun: `bunx --bun @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.4 ops status ...` -> 'status: 1/1 ready, 0 issue(s)'; `ops policy` -> 'passed: 6, failed: 0'.
Scratch copy deleted afterwards.

pm-github: installed as managed extension pm-github@2026.9.26 (npm:pm-github); read-only preview `pm github sync --repo unbraind/pm-ops --dry-run` -> '[dry-run] Would update 0 issue(s) on unbraind/pm-ops; 1 already in sync/failed.' No issues created/modified, no scheduled sync.

Fix driven by jscpd 5.4.0: its one-token scan now sums overlapping clone spans into duplicatedLines (23 > 22 total lines on the TSX fixture), which the fail-closed report validation rejected as impossible counts. parseJscpdReport now validates duplicatedLines against the sum of reported clone spans (and each clone span against total lines) instead of duplicatedLines <= total lines; parity/completeness tests updated, duplication.ts branch coverage back to 100%.

value.text: pm test --run receipts: linked 'pm health --strict-exit --require-merge-drivers' passes (exit 0, seeded tracker context). Linked 'npm run release:check' cannot run faithfully under the pm test harness on 2026.10.4: every seeding context (schema/auto/tracker) injects the sandbox PM_PATH, redirecting the suite's own 'pm init' throwaway workspaces so test/verify-lifecycle-policy.test.ts fails ENOENT on its drift fixture; --env-clear PM_PATH is reserved; per-test pm_context_mode=none requires an isolated workspace which is empty (npm: Missing script) or a snapshot which loses git-tag context (4 unrelated failures). The direct command — exactly what CI runs — is green (466/466, coverage 100/100/100/100). Filed upstream as unbraind/pm-cli#1391 (follow-up to #1318/#1354). Upstream issues referenced by pm-ops tests: #773 (driver/fence drift reported-not-gated), #921/#922 (merge receipts local-only).
